title: Crestline Business Points Award Chart
content:
Company points of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements are listed against award tickets and upgrades at the points below. The chart is the same on all six tiers, from Crestline Business Connect to Crestline Corporate Strategic.

### Round-trip award tickets

| Award | Listed points |
|---|---|
| Domestic Crestline Main Cabin round trip | 1600 |
| Domestic Crestline First round trip | 3200 |
| Short-haul international Crestline Main Cabin round trip | 2400 |
| Long-haul international Crestline Main Cabin round trip | 4200 |
| Long-haul international Crestline Premium Economy round trip | 7200 |

### Confirmed upgrades

| Upgrade | Listed points per segment |
|---|---|
| Segment up to the segment-length threshold in miles set by Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand | 300 |
| Longer segment | 600 |

### Notes to the chart

- Upgrade points are counted per segment: a hypothetical itinerary of two segments, one up to the segment-length threshold and one longer, lists 300 and 600 points, together 900 points.
- A long-haul international round trip is listed at 4200 points in Crestline Main Cabin and at 7200 points in Crestline Premium Economy.
- The chart lists the same points for every tier of the agreement.
